title: ソリューション／勝ちたい

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wow, everyone came to watch!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Race estimated to begin in five, four, three, two—
Mejiro McQueen sprints out the moment the gates open.
Yesterday…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hello, Rice. Would you like to observe an on-campus scrimmage with me tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Uhhh… huh?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It's a high-level, long-distance scrimmage between runners active in classic- and senior-year graded races.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen, the favorite to win the spring Tenno Sho, will be running.
Mejiro McQueen is a genteel Umamusume who carries the weight and responsibility of the Mejiro family on her shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Research is essential if you wish to win. Observing this scrimmage will be beneficial for you as well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-but why do you want to watch it with me?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …? That is because…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I cannot explain it well, but perhaps it is because I am feeling "restless."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I believe I am experiencing the same "desire to win" regarding the spring Tenno Sho as you are.
Ka-thunk!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And the race begins! Wow! Looking at the size of the crowd today, you'd never think it was a mere scrimmage!

text_block_list.name: McQueen Fan A
text_block_list.text: You can do it, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: McQueen Fan B
text_block_list.text: There's no way she's losing this! She's got it in the bag!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Based on the enthusiasm of the spectators' cheers, I have verified Mejiro McQueen's exceptional popularity among fans.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Here we go! The front of the pack has hit the curve and is heading into the fourth corner!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Just who will get there first?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hah!
Mejiro McQueen pulls away from the group and swiftly widens the gap between her and the second-place runner.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon and Rice
text_block_list.text: Amazing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAH!
In a show of overwhelming skill, Mejiro McQueen flies past the goal.

text_block_list.name: McQueen Fan A
text_block_list.text: Did you see that?! She won by a whole seven lengths! McQueen is seriously something else!

text_block_list.name: McQueen Fan B
text_block_list.text: I could watch her run full-throttle like that anytime, anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your words of praise. I'm honored to receive them.

text_block_list.name: McQueen Fans
text_block_list.text: Woooooh!
Mejiro McQueen's elegant smile elicits even more excitement from the crowd around her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: McQueen was u-unbelievable… Wow!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I concur. She possesses a great degree of skill and an air of elegance to match.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I can actually beat her…
Rice Shower shrinks in on herself dejectedly after witnessing such an amazing display of running.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: She is indeed spectacular. However, I am still feeling the "desire to win."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So you really do want to win!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, well… I was surprised when you said you wanted to win the spring Tenno Sho yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You've… never really acted like that before.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That is accurate. I have certainly undergone some changes.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: For reasons I cannot explain, certain memories keep returning to me unbidden from time to time…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Memories of the "restlessness" I felt at the Kikuka Sho and your incredible show of power during the race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It has taken me some time to accept it. But now…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My "desire to win" has become a solid source of power for me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-you feel that way from running with me?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's why I want to win the spring Tenno Sho… or rather, that is why I will win it.
Impressed by Mihono Bourbon's growth, Rice Shower gives a small nod.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …I see. I understand now.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I want to win too. No, I don't just want to win. I will win!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So, um, I'll see you at the spring Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Affirmative. I will see you there.
The next day…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, pant!
Mihono Bourbon's running form has stabilized and returned to normal.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hah!
I feel like she's somehow gotten even better!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Lap time stability confirmed. I apologize for having caused you so much trouble.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master… There is something I must report. Or, more accurately, there is something I must confer with you about.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I originally experienced "discomfort" regarding my "desire to win"…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, now that I comprehend what it is, I find surrendering myself to this capricious emotion to be quite comforting.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That is all I wished to confer with you about. I will now proceed to the next segment of my training regimen.
Mihono Bourbon has acquired a useful weapon that will help her prepare for the spring Tenno Sho.
She's taken another step forward in her growth, and continues to race toward greater heights!
